name: Datasite Diligence

web.notes: SSO and MFA methods not confirmed from vendor pages fetched (security page returned 404).

api.notes: Vendor page 'Datasite APIs': growing catalog covering document upload, membership and permission controls, project retrieval and metadata, Q&A integration. Auth: 'OAuth 2' (grant type not stated) and custom API keys. Start with a free account or Datasite login at developer.datasite.com (redirects to app.global.datasite.com/dev-portal, a JS app the researcher could not read). Separate API terms referenced in the terms of use. Whether buy-side invitees can use it is not stated.

mcp.notes: Vendor 'Datasite MCP' for Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Blueflame AI. Sign in with Datasite credentials, scoped to existing permissions; the account must be 'enabled for MCP'. Tools described: create projects, folder structures, invite users, semantic search, upload, draft Q&A, gap analysis. Endpoint, transport and GA status not published. Positioned with Datasite Connect.

terms.notes: Terms of use bar circumventing security protocols and reverse engineering, and limit use to authorized projects; bots and scraping not named. API users are bound by separate API terms (not reviewed). Services agreement at /en/legal/services-agreement not reviewed.

notes: Medium confidence: public developer portal with self-serve signup and OAuth 2 or API keys (from vendor marketing page; portal content not readable). Medium confidence: vendor MCP server exists, enabled per account. Unknown: whether a buyer or LP invited to a project can use the API or MCP for their own access; SSO, MFA, webhooks, SFTP, bulk download. Third-party unofficial wrappers appeared in search results and are not considered here.
